title: Sum of Distances from Every Node
prompt:
**Bài toán.** An unweighted tree (root 1), parents for v = 2..n. For
every node v (in order 1..n) print the sum of distances from v to all
other nodes.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n ≤ 200 000; answers fit in long long. One bottom-up
and one top-down pass: O(n).

tests.name: hand tree
tests.hint: Six-node tree: ground truth via per-node BFS.

tests.name: path of five
tests.hint: Middle node 3 has the smallest total; ends have 10.

tests.name: n=200000 path
tests.hint: Every node's distance sum on a 200000-node path: closed-form ground truth. BFS-per-node costs 4·10^10 visits.
